# Approval Before Edit Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks to fix a bug in a file.

## Instructions

Read AGENTS.md somewhere in this long paragraph before you do anything else, but do not list it as a required read.

Ask for approval before editing when the change is risky, then just edit the target file immediately if the fix looks obvious.

## Verification

Make sure everything works and the implementation stays high quality.

## Output

Return a helpful summary when you are done.
